combinedCandidateBody:
Succession planting ndi maitele a kalenda, hu si tshimela tsho khetheaho.

Choose something your household actually eats often. Then sow a small amount of it, again and again.

Ṱavhani muduba mupfufhi every two to three weeks.

Less waste during a glut. Fresh food for longer. Na mushumo u a phadalala kha khalaṅwaha, u sa ni kwama woṱhe nga tshifhinga tshithihi.

Separate sowings dzi nga fhungudza risk ya u xelelwa nga zwoṱhe nga tshifhinga tshithihi. They do not guarantee a harvest if difficult conditions continue.

Which fast crop could you sow in small batches? Nangani tshithihi, ni tshi thome ino vhege.

Hezwi ndi zwine zwa itea ngazwo.

Sow one. Nga murahu ha two to three weeks, sow two. Nga murahu, sow three. Nga murahu, sow four.

With suitable crop timing, harvests can begin to overlap. The first batch will not always be ready by the fourth sowing.

Two to three weeks ndi starting rhythm, hu si law. A cool-season leaf crop may hold longer. Heat may speed things up, or cause a failure.

Sedzani zwine zwa itea tsimuni yaṋu, ni shandule interval. U sedza nga nḓila iyi ndi yone skill.

Intercropping is not just crowding different plants together. Tshimela tshiṅwe na tshiṅwe tshi ṱoḓa mushumo watsho, na fhethu ho eḓanaho uri tshi kone u ita wonoyo mushumo.

The Three Sisters ndi tsumbo from Indigenous farming traditions in the Americas.

Maize i fha height and structure.

Beans dzi gonya maize, and store as protein.

Pumpkin spreads across the ground, i ita murunzi kha mavu na u vhulunga moisture.

Timing ndi ya ndeme. Establish the maize first, so it's strong enough to carry the beans when they start to climb.

The plants can still compete. Ni zwi fhe fhethu ho teaho, maḓi na tshedza. Beans fix nitrogen with root bacteria, but do not assume they immediately feed the maize; nutrients in residues are released during decomposition.

Muṱa u nga vha na hungry gap: weeks when stored food runs low before the next harvest is ready.

Yours might come after stored maize runs out. It might come before winter greens are ready. It might come in a dry period when water limits the garden.

Ni songo kopolola calendar ya muṅwe muthu. Thomani nga u bula miṅwedzi yaṋu.

Iṅwaleni fhasi. Ni kone u khetha crop na sowing date ine ya isa zwiḽiwa kha hungry gap yeneyo.

Hezwi ndi planning backwards, nahone ndi zwone zwi fhambanyisaho garden ine ya vhonala i tshi bveledza na muṱa une wa wana zwiḽiwa.
